q: Amari's α-connections ∇^{(α)} on a statistical manifold form a one-parameter family. The dually flat pair (e-flat, m-flat) corresponds to:
exp: The e-connection (α=+1) and m-connection (α=−1) are dual with respect to the Fisher metric: they are related by (∇^{(α)})^* = ∇^{(-α)} under metric duality. The Levi-Civita connection is α=0 (the Riemannian connection), which is its own dual.
